description: Review rubric for DPP / mock / diagnostic question records (question bank items). Used by SMEs during sme_reviewed → senior_approved transitions.

criteria.label: Subject correctness
criteria.description: Is the question factually correct? Is the marked answer actually right under the stated conditions?

criteria.label: Statement clarity
criteria.description: Is the question stem unambiguous? Are all symbols/units defined? Could a competent student misread it?

criteria.label: Difficulty calibration
criteria.description: Does the assigned difficulty tag (1-5) match how hard the question actually is? Junior+Senior may disagree; senior wins.

criteria.label: Solution quality
criteria.description: Is the step-by-step solution complete, pedagogically clear, free of leaps? Does it address why the right answer is right + why each distractor is wrong?

criteria.label: NEET/JEE alignment
criteria.description: Does the question match real exam pattern (length, distractor style, common-trap structure)? Or does it feel synthetic?

approval_rule: All criteria with minimum_pass must be met. Senior reviewer overrides junior on disagreement.
